name: Soul sax calls
desc: Smoky VCSL saxophone phrases in Ab major: a two-bar call landing on the six, answered by a falling line, vibrato takes on the long notes. King Curtis after midnight - shaped hot so the horn sits forward in the mix.

code.full: note("<[eb4@2 f4 g4] [f4@3 eb4] [c4@2 ab3 bb3] [c4@4]>").add(note(${root})).s("<sax sax sax_vib sax>").clip("<1 1 1.4 1.8>").shape(.35).gain(${gain}).room(${breath}).roomsize(4).hpf(170).pan(cosine.range(.45,.55).slow(12)).lastOf(8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.8)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[eb4 f4 g4 bb4] [f4@2 eb4 c4] [c4 ab3 bb3 c4] [eb4@2 f4@2]>").s("sax").clip(.9).shape(.4).gain(${gain}), note("<~ [ab4@3 g4] ~ [g4@2 ab4@2]>").s("sax_vib").clip(1.2).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.7).pan(.6)).add(note(${root})).room(${breath}).roomsize(3.5).hpf(180).orbit(5).play()
